description: This file defines an abstract base class for multi-valued predicates used in querying MongoDB within the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides core logic for handling predicate values, equality, and string representation.

classes.name: AbstractMultiPredicate
classes.description: Abstract class for predicates with multiple values, implementing core methods for equality, hash, and string representation.

methods.name: AbstractMultiPredicate
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the predicate with an unmodifiable copy of the input values list.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Returns the list of predicate values.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on the values list.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on the values list.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation including class name and values.
